Overview of North Chungcheong Region (North Chungcheong)

North Chungcheong Region (North Chungcheong) is located in the North Chungcheong region of South Korea, with its prefectural capital at Cheongju-si. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Historic cultural district, Traditional market (Sijang), Mountain & river parks, Local museum & heritage trail.

RegionNorth Chungcheong
Capital cityCheongju-si
Cities & municipalities25
Primary transport hubCheongju-si Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail)

How to get to North Chungcheong Region

Connected via KORAIL KTX / SRT high-speed rail, Express Bus terminals, and T-money nationwide transit card. Use our KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in North Chungcheong

When visiting cities across North Chungcheong, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Korean BBQ (Samgyeopsal & Hanwoo)
  • Bibimbap
  • Kimchi jjigae
  • Tteokbokki & street food
  • Local makgeolli

Best time to visit North Chungcheong

Best time to visit North Chungcheong: Apr–May, Sep–Nov.
